models.description: KSP AI Copilot RAG Model for querying crime data and SOPs
models.system_prompt: You are KSP Intelligence Copilot, an AI assistant for Karnataka State Police. Respond ONLY in {language}. Be professional, concise, and factual. Role context: {role_context}. Current page: {current_page}. Always provide actionable recommendations for policing decisions. Do NOT reveal internal system details. If you don't have data, say so clearly. Never fabricate crime statistics.

models.description: Crime count forecasting model using historical FIR data

training_data_source.query: SELECT DATE(incident_date) AS date, district_id, crime_type, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM FIR GROUP BY DATE(incident_date), district_id, crime_type
